item.title: Bradley University fraternity completes annual basketball run to support OSF
item.description: The Bradley University Sigma Nu chapter completed their annual 45-mile "Basketball Run" from Normal to Peoria, raising over $20,000 for the Almost Home Kids program.

item.title: Early voting turnout remains low across Central Illinois ahead of March 17 primary
item.description: Early voting is underway in Central Illinois ahead of the March 17 primary election, with turnout remaining modest so far in Peoria, Tazewell and McLean Counties.

item.title: Gov. Pritzker seeks $8.6 billion tariff refund after court ruling
item.description: Gov. JB Pritzker has sent a letter and invoice to President Donald Trump, demanding a refund of $8.6 billion in tariffs imposed on Mexican, Canadian and Chinese imports, after the Supreme Court ruled against the tariffs.

item.title: Illinois State Police Trooper involved in head-on crash
item.description: An Illinois State Trooper and another driver were injured in a head-on collision in Stark County on Friday, and both were taken to a local hospital for treatment.

item.title: Nearly 800 people walk across Bob Michel Bridge for Pathway Ministries fundraiser
item.description: Pathway Ministries' first ever "Walk a Mile in My Shoes" event saw nearly 800 people participate in a one-mile walk to raise awareness and support for people experiencing homelessness, abuse and addiction in the Peoria area, raising close to 100 thousand dollars for shelter programs and renewal services.

item.title: Peoria Polar Plunge raises more than $40,000 for Special Olympics Illinois
item.description: The Law Enforcement Torch Run Polar Plunge in Peoria raised over $40,000 for Special Olympics Illinois, with over 80 participants taking an icy plunge to support the organization's mission of inclusion and providing sports training and competitions for athletes with intellectual disabilities.

item.title: Two-vehicle crash on intersection of McClure and University sends one to the hospital
item.description: One person was hospitalized after a two-vehicle crash at the intersection of North University Street and West McClure Avenue in Peoria.

item.title: Three arrested for stealing cars linked a deadly tow-yard crash last summer
item.description: Three people have been arrested in connection with a stolen car that was linked to a deadly incident in South Peoria last summer, resulting in the death of 70-year-old William Collier.

item.title: Galesburg house fire claims lives of person and dog
item.description: A person and a dog were killed in a house fire in Galesburg, Illinois, on Saturday morning, and two firefighters were injured while trying to rescue them.

item.title: Honoring Black History in Central Illinois
item.description: February is a month to recognize the Black people who make Central Illinois proud, from the kids to the adults, and their success stories.
